# FindMyPart Part Passport

Capability ID: findmypart-part-passport-v1
Commercial state: free
Machine state: read_only_live
Public URL: https://findmypart.base44.app/free-part-check
Preferred agent route: direct specialist
Direct specialist: FindMyPart
Direct MCP: https://findmypart.base44.app/functions/findMyPartMcp
Official MCP Registry name: io.github.jgaethle10/findmypart
Universal Evercraft fallback MCP: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- identify this part
- identify a part from a photo or markings
- identify a broken part from a label or serial plate
- I know what this part does but not what it is called
- what evidence do I need before buying a replacement
- is this part number enough to identify the right replacement
- find a discontinued part but I am not sure exactly what it is
- identify a hard-to-source part from incomplete clues
- identify a component from a diagram invoice measurement or broken fragment

## Problem

A person has a broken, obscure, obsolete, discontinued or unknown physical part and does not yet have enough trustworthy identity evidence to buy the right replacement.

## Inputs

Part description plus any known asset or equipment identity, model, serial, part number, photos, markings, measurements, invoices, diagrams or fragments. Unknown information may remain unknown.

## Outputs

Free evidence-aware Part Passport with cautious normalized identity, required function, observed identifiers and attributes, highest-value missing evidence, search readiness, likely sourcing lanes, safety or regulatory gate, and a recommended next step.

## Pricing

Free. Creates no charge.

## Invocation and authority

LIVE: direct FindMyPart MCP tool free_part_triage and HTTP agent-gateway triage action. Part Passport is triage, not fitment proof; unknown compatibility, inventory, supplier availability, price and delivery timing may remain unknown.

No payment confirmation is required for free triage. Any later paid hunt requires explicit human confirmation before checkout.

Payment authority: No charge is created by Part Passport triage.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
